assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations accompanied by episodes of dizziness and giddiness that have persisted despite initial evaluation.
To correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity, a Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring study is ordered for continuous ambulatory monitoring.
A Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring study (CPT 93229) is ordered.
The CPT code for the study is 93229.
The diagnosis R00.2 supports the clinical indication.
The diagnosis R42 supports the clinical indication.
